14558128.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
14558128.text: When a card or effect is activated that includes any of these effects (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; negate that effect. ● Add a card(s) from the Deck to the hand. ● Special Summon a Monster Card(s) from the Deck. ● Send a card(s) from the Deck to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring" once per turn.
